g.text: In-cluster stores with their own UIs. vlagent ships every log; vmagent scrapes K8s metrics. Zabbix watches hosts separately.
No Grafana: vmui and the LogsQL UI are the dashboard layer.
vmalert is off until an application-level alert needs it; vm-operator is Phase 8b.
vlagent over Vector or Fluent Bit: several times the throughput at a fraction of the CPU.
Sources: docs/services/observability.md, docs/services/zabbix.md. K3s hosts reach VictoriaLogs through a ClusterIP: node networking cannot reach MetalLB VIPs.
